title: The Central Eskimo
version: Sixth Annual Report of the Bureau of Ethnology 1884–85, pp. 399–670; Gutenberg transcription
lineage: Public-domain transcription of a 19th-century ethnographic text. Its introductory statement says it combines the author’s observations and accounts by others; the bound used is publication, not an invented date of observation.

passages.note: Printed pp. 486–487: kayak frame, skin cover and cockpit; pp. 539–541: snow blocks built as a rising spiral dome and use as winter travel shelter.
